results.name: toolz-sliding-window
results.summary: Fixed sliding_window in toolz/itertoolz.py by replacing the incorrect deque-based implementation with a correct one using itertools.islice and tee. The change makes the function return the expected overlapping windows. Verified by running the sliding_window tests, which now pass.

results.name: more-itertools-tail
results.summary: Fixed the tail function in more_itertools/recipes.py by ensuring the start index for islice is non-negative (using max(size - n, 0)). This resolves the ValueError when the requested tail size exceeds the iterable length. All tests now pass.

results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed naturalsize decimal mode by setting base=1000 for non-binary, non-gnu cases. Tests now pass.

results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Swapped the implementations of _func_ends_with and _func_starts_with in jmespath/functions.py. The ends_with function was incorrectly using startswith and starts_with was using endswith. After fixing, all function-related compliance tests pass.

results.name: click-intrange-clamp
results.summary: Fixed IntRange._clamp to add direction instead of subtract when bound is open, so that clamp=True with min_open=True correctly clamps values below min to min+1. Verified by running the provided test suite; all tests pass.

results.name: jinja-batch-filter
results.summary: Fixed the jinja2 batch filter by correcting the condition for yielding batches. Changed from yielding when len(tmp) > linecount to yielding when len(tmp) == linecount after appending the item. results.name: packaging-canonicalize
results.summary: Fixed canonicalize_name to replace '.' with '-' as per PEP 503. The function now correctly normalizes names like 'oslo.concurrency' to 'oslo-concurrency'. All tests pass.

results.name: pyparsing-lineno

results.name: tomli-unicode-escape
results.summary: Fixed the parsing of \\uXXXX escapes in basic strings by changing the hex length from 3 to 4 in parse_basic_str_escape. All tests now pass.
